exerciseTitle: How I react in a fight
exerciseSubtitle: Six quick questions, just for you.
questions: When the conversation heats up, what do you do first?
If your partner goes quiet mid-fight, you...
After an argument, what usually happens?
What bothers you most in a fight?
When you notice you went too far, you...
What helps you feel normal again?

options1(map).pursue: I keep talking until it's settled.
options1(map).withdraw: I need some time before going on.
options1(map).repair: I try to lighten the mood.
options1(map).avoid: I change the subject so it doesn't get worse.

options2(map).pursue: I push for them to speak.

options3(map).pursue: I look for the conversation right away.
options3(map).repair: I think about what I can fix.
options3(map).avoid: I'd rather not go back to it.

options4(map).repair: Seeing that we don't understand each other.

options5(map).pursue: I talk even more to explain.
options5(map).withdraw: I close up until I calm down.
options5(map).repair: I apologize or suggest a way to fix it.
options5(map).avoid: I wait for it to cool down.

options6(map).avoid: Carrying on with the day as if nothing happened.

privateNote: Only you see your answers. Nothing is sent to your partner.

descriptions(map).pursue: You tend to seek the conversation right away, even while things are still hot.
descriptions(map).withdraw: You tend to step back first and come back later.
descriptions(map).repair: You tend to look for a way to fix things soon after a fight.
descriptions(map).avoid: You tend to set the subject aside so it doesn't get worse in the moment.

practices(map).pursue: That helps you sort it out fast. Pausing before it gets worse and listening to the end is worth it.
practices(map).withdraw: That helps you pause before it gets worse. Pick a set way to come back.
practices(map).repair: That helps you return after a fight. A short apology often does it.
practices(map).avoid: That helps you pause before it gets worse. Choose a short moment to come back to it.
